description: This Swift source file defines a command-line utility 'TranscribeCommand' that transcribes media files using speech recognition, with configurable options for locale, output format, censoring, and maximum sentence length.

classes.name: TranscribeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command that transcribes an audio or video file into text or SRT format, using speech recognition.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously performs the transcription process by reading the input file, processing speech recognition, and outputting the result either to a file or console.
